# Werkstacks Solutions

> Werkstacks Solutions is a data analytics consultancy that turns scattered business data into dashboards, reporting and automation that operations and finance teams actually use. Remote-first, working across the United States, Germany and the rest of Europe, in English and German.

Not to be confused with Werkstack GmbH (werkstack.dev), an unrelated German company that builds Jira and Confluence apps.

## What Werkstacks does

- **Free data audit** — a non-binding review that maps the data a company already has, what is fixable, and what it would take. No obligation either way.
- **Dashboards and reporting** — Power BI and Excel dashboards built on a structured data model, with automated refresh, plus management reporting with concrete recommendations.
- **Automation** — Excel/VBA and Python automation that removes manual reporting work.
- **Data foundations** — data preparation and structuring, SQL and data modelling, KPI and process analysis.

## How engagements work

A discovery call, then the free data audit, then a scoped proposal. Delivery runs in short increments so clients see progress early, and handover includes documentation so the client's own team can run it. Work is hourly, $40–$120 per hour depending on scope and expertise required. There is no minimum project size — engagements deliberately start with one report or one dashboard that proves the value.

## Data handling

An NDA is signed before any data is shared. Where possible the work uses anonymized or sample data, and wherever the client's setup allows, data stays in the client's own environment.
